sources.ARED_rates: NASA Fracture Evidence Report, Table 4, p.22
sources.pre_ARED_rates: NASA Fracture Evidence Report, Table 4, p.22

assumptions: All generated astronaut measurements are synthetic, not actual NASA records.
Total hip and femoral neck projections use the trochanter rate as a proxy.
The NASA Table 4 does not provide a separate femoral-neck rate.
The trochanter proxy for total hip is also an assumption.
BMD projections use a linear accumulation of the monthly rates.
ARED and pre-ARED projections are both generated because the verified exercise prescription is not available.
Synthetic biomarker values use relative indices, not clinical units.
Preflight aBMD and T-score values are simulated examples.
The mission timeline is a shared simulator assumption.
